claim_scope: extended NVT stability evidence for the strict-PCFF-qualified charged 2x2x2 dense-box subset only

extension_protocol.command: gmx convert-tpr -s nvt.tpr -extend 30 -o nvt_extend50.tpr; gmx mdrun -s nvt_extend50.tpr -deffnm nvt -cpi nvt.cpt -append -ntmpi 1 -ntomp 8 -pin off -reprod

threading.selection_basis: local 200-step CPU-only benchmark; 1x8 and 2x4 were equivalent and 16-thread layouts were slower

analysis_protocol.window_definition: final half of the 50 ps NVT trajectory
pass_requirements: temperature mean over final 25 ps is within 300 +/- 20 K
maximum sampled temperature over final 25 ps is <= 400 K
raw log, edr, cpt, gro, mdp, tpr, and energy xvg artifacts are preserved

known_limitations: This still does not replace an ns-scale TP1 rerun on the historical dense_salt_polymer identity.
This supports only the explicit strict-PCFF-qualified charged 2x2x2 subset, not charged transport readiness.
